metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
AMRAP x 10
10 toes to bar
10 Cal AB
3 wall walks or 10m HSW

gymnastics:
Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 4 mins (00:00)
Copenhagan Plank on Bench
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (5:00)
EMOM x 3 (7:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 3 (10:00)
Jump Into Hollow/Arch x 10
EMOM x 3 (13:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
- Put Ball between feet - Reach Long in the Arch - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 3 (16:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (19:00-22:00)
Beat Swing with Straight legs - to target
Aim for height without losing tension.
the goal is to chain them together
HSW Progression
5 mins - Handstand Kick Up 10 Reps (23:00)
Beginners - Start from a Pike - Pop up with 1 foot only
Aim for soft feet onto wall
5 mins - Nose & toes to wall - Keep in a hollow (28:00)
Accumulate 2 mins total
5 mins - Nose & toes Shoulder taps - (33:00)
Shift Weight between hands
E2MOM - go for a max free standing hold (spotted) (38:00)
5 mins Walk away from wall attempts
5 mins - HSW Attempts or stay with a prior progression (43:00-48:00)

hypertrophy.reasoning: Lower body and anterior core heavily taxed; accessory work builds opposing musculature without interfering with recovery.
